spans.s: वैखरी [vaikharī], 1 Articulate utterance, production of sound; see Malli. on
The faculty of speech; वैखरी सर्ववद्यासु प्रशस्ता Narāyaṇapūrvatāpi.

वैखानस [vaikhānasa], a. (-सी f.) Relating to a hermit, ascetic, monastic; वैखानसं किमनया व्रतमा प्रदानाद् व्यापाररोधि मदनस्य निषेवितव्यम् Ś.1.26. -सः An anchorite, a hermit (वान- प्रस्थ); a Brāhmaṇa in the third order of his religious life; संबद्धवैखानसकन्यकानि (तपोवनानि)
A hermit born from the nails and hair of the god Brahman;
